## About

I received my PhD in Preventive Medicine (Epidemiology) and Public Health, awarded *Summa Cum Laude*, from the University of Granada (Spain) and the Université Libre de Bruxelles (Belgium). I also hold a BSc in Mathematics and Statistics (Open University, UK), an MSc in Biostatistics (University of Newcastle, Australia), an MSc in Epidemiology (ULB), and a Master in Public Health (University of Granada).

After my PhD in 2010, I held postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Cape Town and the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, specialising in epidemiological methods and causal inference (2012–2015). Trained as an Epidemic Intelligence Officer, I have worked as a field epidemiologist with Médecins Sans Frontières and WHO-GOARN in Haiti and sub-Saharan Africa.

My research focuses on **epidemiological methods, causal inference, and socioeconomic inequalities in cancer outcomes**.

## Featured

::: {.feature-grid}

::: {.feature-card}
### Computational Causal Inference for Applied Researchers

Open-access book (with Matthew J. Smith) — nine chapters from potential outcomes and DAGs to TMLE, longitudinal data, mediation, and sensitivity analysis, with ~65 reproducible R and Stata examples.

[Read online](https://migariane.github.io/Causal-Inference-Book/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/migariane/Causal-Inference-Book) · [DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20677995](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20677995)
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Causality Lab

Causal inference research group at the Department of Statistics and Operations Research, University of Granada — the work of its PhD students, current research, and software.

[Meet the team](students/index.qmd) · [Research lines](research/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Conformal Statistical Inference

Distribution-free prediction sets with valid finite-sample coverage — split conformal, conformal quantile regression, full conformal, and Jackknife+.

[Guide (EN)](https://migariane.github.io/ConformalInferenceExplained.html) · [Slides (ES)](https://migariane.github.io/ConformalPrediction_Tutorial_ES.html)
:::
